A.title: The Gates of Ironveil
A.description:
You are Sir Aldric, a wandering knight, arriving at the walled town of Ironveil as dusk bleeds red across the sky.
The town crier shouts that Lord Malachar's forces will reach the valley by dawn. The townsfolk are terrified.
Three paths lie before you.

AA.title: The Whispering Forest
AA.description:
You plunge into the ancient forest north of town, following rumours of a hermit sage who once served the old king.
Owls watch you from gnarled branches. Foxfire flickers between the roots.
Deep in the woods, you find the sage's hut — and a glowing runestone on his table.

AB.title: The Undercroft
AB.description:
You descend into the town's forgotten undercroft, where smugglers once hid contraband beneath the market square.
Damp stone, the smell of old wine, the skitter of rats.
At the far end, a rusted iron door stands ajar — behind it, the distant clank of armour. Malachar's scouts are already inside the walls.

AC.title: The Battlements
AC.description:
You climb the crumbling battlements above the south gate, where a handful of frightened militia are holding torches against the dark.
From here you can see Malachar's campfires stretching across the valley — a hundred flames, maybe more.
An old ballista sits unmaintained at the tower's edge, its mechanism corroded but perhaps still functional.

B1.title: The Sage's Bargain
B1.description:
The sage, hollow-eyed and ancient, explains: the runestone is a Ward of Binding, last used three centuries ago.
If placed at the valley's mouth before dawn, it will seal the pass for a generation.
You ride hard through the night. The stone grows warm in your hands. By the first grey light you press it into the earth — and the ground trembles, the pass buckles, great stones tumbling to block the way.
Malachar's horns sound in fury, far off, too late.

B2.title: Outnumbered in the Dark
B2.description:
The scouts hear you. Torchlight floods the undercroft.
You draw your sword but there are six of them, veterans with crossbows already raised.
They take you prisoner and march you before Malachar himself, who arrives at dawn with his full host.
Ironveil falls. The townsfolk are scattered. Your sword is melted down for horseshoes.

B3.title: The Shot Heard at Dawn
B3.description:
You spend the night with oil, rags, and a hammer — coaxing the old ballista back to life.
The militia gather round, wide-eyed, learning to crank and aim.
At first light, Malachar's vanguard charges the gate. Your first bolt takes out the battering ram. Your second scatters the cavalry.
The third never needs to fly. A trumpet sounds retreat. The valley is silent.
The townsfolk name you Warden of Ironveil, and for once, you stay.

GOOD_ENDING.title: Ironveil Stands
GOOD_ENDING.description:
The sun rises over a free town. Smoke curls from morning hearths, not burning thatch.
Children run in the square again. The militia raise a rough-carved wooden statue in your likeness by the gate — it's nothing like you, but you don't mind.
Tales of Ironveil's deliverance will be told in taverns for a hundred years.

✦  YOU HAVE TRIUMPHED  ✦

BAD_ENDING.title: The Fall of Ironveil
BAD_ENDING.description:
Malachar's banner flies from the keep. The market stalls are ash. The bell tower is silent.
You sit in chains in a cold cell beneath the castle, listening to the distant weeping of the townsfolk.
Perhaps someone else will come. Perhaps not.

✦  YOUR QUEST HAS ENDED  ✦

choices.A,AA: Ride north into the Whispering Forest
choices.A,AC: Climb the battlements and take stock
choices.AA,B1: Take the runestone and ride for the pass
choices.AB,B2: Push through the iron door toward the sound
choices.AC,B3: Spend the night repairing the ballista
choices.B1,GOOD_ENDING: Place the Ward of Binding at the valley's mouth
choices.B3,GOOD_ENDING: Hold the gate at dawn with your militia
